comission_idea.JPG.Description: General poses, blocking e.g. for this commission. The characters are both wearing grey tracksuits, there are no requirements specifying detail, feel free to block mechanically complex shapes in to less complex ones. Feel free to reorient objects and change perspective as needed. There are no hard and fast requirements, this is just intended to give you an idea of what I thought would look good.
